about.title: A 10-year pioneer of gamified assessment
about.subtitle: From Pakistan's first gamified corporate training to a global product company — registered in Pakistan, UAE, Canada and Indonesia.
about.whoBody: Intwish is a digital innovation company building immersive learning and assessment platforms for enterprises, governments and development organizations. Our solutions combine gamification, AR/VR and AI to deliver measurable outcomes in training, recruitment, performance and customer engagement. AI is embedded in all of our solutions based on a scientific assessment of the need, outcome and business case.
about.gamBody: Gamification uses game mechanics — avatars, storyboards, stages, scoring, competition and leaderboards — in non-game systems to improve engagement. In training and recruitment it gives employees hands-on learning and assesses candidates against real-world situations in a role-playing, simulated reality. In customer experience it drives brand awareness and loyalty through cash-backs, rewards and incentives. Intwish pioneered gamification in Pakistan and has assessed and trained over 300,000 unique users in 10 years.
about.teamSubtitle: Visionaries, engineers and storytellers driving innovation.
about.entitiesSubtitle: Registered entities and offices across four countries, with project history in Saudi Arabia.
about.originTitle: Built to do what point solutions can't
about.originBody: Intwish started in 2015 with a simple conviction: games belong in the corporate world. We set out to automate the tedious, change how results are achieved and prove that engagement and rigor can coexist in talent technology.

faq.title: Questions buyers ask us
faq.subtitle: Straight answers regarding validity, candidate experience, compliance, and pricing.

validity.a: Yes. intOS is built on Cattell-Horn-Carroll (CHC) cognitive theory and Situational Judgment Test (SJT) research — psychometric frameworks with decades of criterion-related validity evidence. The platform has been validated across 300,000+ candidates in 5 markets.

differs.q: How does intOS differ from Pymetrics, Arctic Shores, or Vervoe?
differs.a: intOS is the only platform that combines a full virtual OS environment (email, messenger, video SJT, calendar) with branching decision consequences, CHC cognitive games, and a recruiter drag-and-drop Scenario Builder — while providing native KSA and Pakistan data residency.

experience.q: What does the experience feel like for candidates?
experience.a: Like the first day of a new job. Candidates operate a realistic virtual desktop on phone or laptop, in English or Arabic, with light or dark themes. Familiar workplace scenarios reduce anxiety, measuring real ability rather than test nerves.

scoring.a: Every click, email reply, chat response, and SJT decision is scored automatically against your configured competency rubric. The recruiter dashboard surfaces ranked shortlists, funnel analytics, and 1-click PDF reports.

ats.q: Does intOS integrate with our ATS?
ats.a: Yes. intOS integrates natively with major ATS platforms including Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle Taleo, Greenhouse, and Lever for automated candidate invites and score sync.

compliance.a: intOS offers native local data residency in Saudi Arabia (KSA) and Pakistan, complying fully with PDPL, SAMA, SBP, and NDMO data regulations.

pricing.a: Priced per candidate per volume band, localized to your market's currency (AED, SAR, PKR, CAD, USD). Teams typically start with a pilot drive before scaling. Contact us for a custom quote within 24–48 hours.

science.methodologyTitle: From job analysis to a scored experience
science.methodologySubtitle: A defensible method, applied consistently across every engagement.

methodology.p1: Situational-judgement method: candidates respond to realistic, job-relevant scenarios — measuring judgment and decision-making with less cultural bias and faking than traditional self-report tests.
methodology.p2: Game-based cognitive assessment: validated games (e.g. Numbubbles, Numparision, Word Wizard) measure cognitive ability and personality traits in an engaging, anxiety-reducing format.
methodology.p3: Construct mapping: every game and scenario maps to the competencies your role requires, so scores have clear meaning and connect to on-the-job success.
methodology.p4: AI scoring with evidence: wherever AI grades, it applies one rubric consistently and quotes verbatim evidence — the same standard every candidate meets.

science.biasTitle: AI as a copilot, not a judge
science.biasIntro: We design for fairness from the ground up — the human stays in the decision, and the machine shows its work.

bias.p1: One rubric for every candidate: the AI scores all candidates against the same criteria, removing interviewer-dependent variance.
bias.p2: Verbatim evidence: every AI rating cites exactly what a candidate said or did, so a human reviewer can verify each decision.
bias.p3: A human in the loop: AI surfaces patterns and ranked evidence; your panel makes the final call. We publish our fairness commitments as a roadmap.

science.dataSubtitle: Every assessment is a data relationship we take seriously.

data.p1: Consent-first and minimized: we collect only what the assessment needs, with candidate consent and clear purpose.
data.p2: Retention you control: data is kept for the length of your program and deleted or returned per your policy.
data.p3: Ethical by default: candidate data is never sold, and access is role-based and audited.

science.academicSubtitle: A founding tie to academic psychology underpins why our methods work.

academic.p1: Our assessment framework draws on industrial & organizational psychology and psychometric research on game-based and situational-judgement assessment.
academic.p2: This evidence base is cited in every client report — connecting our tools to published research rather than untested novelty.
academic.p3: We keep investing in research and invite scrutiny of our methods, treating validation as a discipline, not a marketing claim.
